#police #arrest #cops 

On May 14th, 2023. An officer was on routine patrol when he observed a male who had an active warrant in a vehicle. When the officer approached him, he started being an a**hole to the officers. It was also brought to light that he was in a physical altercation with his roommates. The officers spoke to the roommates and stated how he had been an a**hole to them and that everyone in the neighborhood had a problem with him including his girlfriend. He was identified as Matt.
